description: A shell script intended for automating OpenWrt package dependency testing, including environment setup, package testing, and build management.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message and terminates the script.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: deptest_make
methods.description: Runs a make command for a given target with specific environment variables, logging output.

methods.name: clean_kernel_build_dir
methods.description: Cleans the kernel build directory, preserving kernel source directories.

methods.name: stamp_exists
methods.description: Checks if a stamp (file or symlink) exists.

methods.name: test_package
methods.description: Tests a specific package by building it if not already marked as successful or blacklisted.

methods.name: bootstrap_deptest_make
methods.description: Runs a bootstrap make command for a specified target, logging output.

methods.name: bootstrap_native_make
methods.description: Runs a native bootstrap make command with logging.
